user_instruction: 同一題答案版本不一樣應該選擇v26 ppl最低的答案作為標準
metric: exp(sum of negative log probabilities / number of supervised assistant answer tokens, including assistant EOS)
conditioning: Full causal native-v26 input with the same task, skills, constraints, tools and observations. Never count prompt, memory, tool-observation or padding tokens in the denominator.
grouping: Identical task inputs and output contracts; changed tool registries or observations are different conditions. Remove only explicitly enumerated generic OpenOrca teacher-style prompts before scoring, while preserving the user task and skill context. Source prompts that change the requested task remain separate or held.
eligibility: Existing license, first-negative hold, contamination, causal chronology, typed-argument and full-budget gates remain in force. PPL ranks eligible answers; it is not a correctness test.
selection: Score every distinct eligible answer in a competing-input group, then retain the minimum mean answer NLL. Exact ties use record_id. A failed, missing or nonfinite score holds the group; no silent first-source fallback.
numerics: Canonical batch size one, full unpadded sequence, FlashAttention, released BF16 weights plus original FP32 Mamba parameters, sequence-aligned 128-token vocabulary projections, FP32 per-token cross entropy and FP64 summation. No ranking from padded multi-sequence batches after the calibration delta exceeded 0.01 NLL. No change to quality gates or model weights.
scope: Reconsider pre-deduplication original answer candidates, including answers formerly removed by source ordering. Preserve sealed previous artifacts and first negative semantic decisions.
